spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Airy, editorial, and sophisticated. Use massive padding (p-16 to p-32) to let the typography and imagery breathe.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grids: Use Mode A (Tetris Grid) for 'Community Impact' and 'Services'. Asymmetry creates tension.
spacing_and_layout.corners: Slightly rounded (rounded-xl or rounded-2xl) but lean towards sharp/minimalist (rounded-none for editorial images).

surfaces_and_materials.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' for Contact Panel and Sticky Header: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)].
surfaces_and_materials.cards: Premium floating cards with soft ambient shadow on hover (shadow-2xl shadow-champagne/10), 1px solid platinum border (border-platinum).

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis is MANDATORY. Momentum scrolling is critical for the premium Awwwards feel.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line headline reveal using Framer Motion (y: 100% to 0, overflow hidden wrapper).
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle y-axis shifts on large images during scroll.
motion_and_interactions.pseudo_3d: Use react-parallax-tilt or framer-motion for Services floating cards (tilt and reflection effect on hover).
motion_and_interactions.orbital_hub: Company Ecosystem (3 companies) orbit around the Kailash Group logo. Use Framer Motion for continuous slow rotation of the container, and counter-rotation for the items to keep them upright.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire site to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glows: Awards timeline should feature a very soft radial gradient glow (champagne colored) behind the glowing trophies.
visual_enhancers.lighting: Realistic lighting emulation on 3D elements via CSS drop-shadows with multiple layers.

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header. Must be z-50. Minimalist logo left, links center, CTA right.
components_strategy.services_cards: Floating tall bento cards. Animate on hover with depth (scale up 1.02, elevate shadow).
components_strategy.awards_timeline: Horizontal scrolling or flex-row timeline. Elegant minimal vertical lines connecting the nodes.
components_strategy.about_timeline: Refined corporate timeline spanning ~20 years. Large elegant typography for years.
components_strategy.contact_panel: Split layout. Left: Enquiry form (Shadcn customized). Right: Embedded interactive Google Map of Parramatta NSW wrapped in glassmorphism border.
components_strategy.marquee: One slow editorial marquee (Serif font, wide spacing) reading values like 'INTEGRITY • EXCELLENCE • TRUST'.

hero_bg.description: Australian city skyline (Sydney) waterfront, premium view for parallax background.

legal_services.description: Elegant justice scales on a premium office desk.

amit_pall_portrait.description: Professional male corporate leader portrait for About section.

koala_conservation.description: Koala bear on a tree for Community Impact section.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio. Since it's a light theme, use Deep Onyx (#111111) for text.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the parallax and orbital hub.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No generic centered layouts. Emphasize asymmetry and tension.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic by using generous padding (p-16, p-24) and crisp, 1px subtle borders (border-black/5).
Never apply 'transition: all' as it breaks Framer Motion transforms.
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Every interactive element must have hover states (color shift, subtle translate).
All key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute for testing.
For the UI, the user explicitly chose a LIGHT/white premium theme instead of dark. No dark mode by default.
If implementing the orbital hub, ensure it is fully responsive, breaking down to a grid on mobile if orbiting is too complex for small screens.
